adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` the error handler builds `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;` and then calls `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), "error")`. A template literal always returns a non-empty string even when `err.data?.code` or `err.message` are `undefined`, producing e.g. `"undefined: undefined"`, which is truthy. Therefore the `|| t("unable_to_add_guests")` fallback is unreachable and the user can see the unintended `undefined` text.
